mapper.select: select target_id, count(*) as comment_count from blog_comment where target_type = #{targetType} and deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 group by target_id
mapper.insert: insert into blog_comment (user_id, target_id, target_type, content, parent_id, reply_user_id, ip_address, ip_region, review, deleted_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyUserId}, #{ipAddress}, #{ipRegion}, #{review}, 0, #{createTime}, now())

select c.id, up.avatar, up.nickname, c.user_id, c.ip_region, c.create_time, c.content, ifnull(lc.like_count, 0) as like_count, ifnull(rc.reply_count, 0) as reply_count from blog_comment c left join blog_user_profile up on c.user_id = up.user_id and up.deleted_at = 0 left join (select parent_id, count(*) as reply_count from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 group by parent_id) rc on c.id = rc.parent_id left join (select target_id, count(*) as like_count from blog_like_record where type = 3 and status = 1 group by target_id) lc on c.id = lc.target_id where c.target_type = #{type} and c.target_id = #{typeId} and c.parent_id is null and c.deleted_at = 0 and c.review = 0
order by (ifnull(lc.like_count, 0) * 0.6 + ifnull(rc.reply_count, 0) * 0.4) desc, c.create_time desc
order by c.create_time desc
limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from blog_comment where target_type = #{type} and target_id = #{typeId} and parent_id is null and deleted_at = 0 and review = 0
select parent_id as target_id, count(*) as comment_count from blog_comment where parent_id is not null and deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 group by parent_id

select c.id, up.avatar, up.nickname, c.user_id, c.ip_region, c.create_time, c.content, c.reply_user_id, rp.nickname as reply_nickname, c.parent_id, ifnull(lc.like_count, 0) as like_count from blog_comment c left join blog_user_profile up on c.user_id = up.user_id and up.deleted_at = 0 left join blog_user_profile rp on c.reply_user_id = rp.user_id and rp.deleted_at = 0 left join (select target_id, count(*) as like_count from blog_like_record where type = 3 and status = 1 group by target_id) lc on c.id = lc.target_id where c.parent_id = #{parentId} and c.deleted_at = 0 and c.review = 0
order by like_count desc, c.create_time desc
order by c.create_time desc
limit #{offset}, #{size}
